title: In China’s Biggest Car Recall, Tesla and 8 Others Will Address Door Safety
summary_full: China’s regulator ordered changes after vehicle occupants sometimes had difficulty exiting electric cars, an issue that has led to lawsuits against Tesla in the United States.
